title: Koko Head Crater Hike and Halona Beach Cove Relaxation
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Challenge yourselves with a rewarding hike up Koko Head Crater Trail, where stunning panoramic views of East Oahu await. After your hike, unwind at the picturesque Halona Beach Cove, enjoying time to swim and relax in the beautiful bay. This tour combines adventure and relaxation in one unforgettable morning.

- Hike the iconic Koko Head Crater Trail for amazing views
- Enjoy approximately 1-1.5 hours for the round trip hike
- Spend an hour swimming and relaxing at Halona Beach Cove
- Ideal for outdoor enthusiasts looking for a blend of fitness and leisure
